facts.fact: Under SBM (Gramin) Phase-II an incentive of Rs 12,000 per household is given for building an Individual Household Latrine (IHHL), including water storage for hygiene, handwashing and cleaning
facts.quote: Incentive for construction of IHHLs (BPLs and Identified APLs) Rs. 12,000/- (including for water storage facility for maintaining hygiene, handwashing and cleanliness)

facts.fact: It is given only to new eligible households, including all BPL households
facts.quote: Incentive of Rs.12,000/- for construction of IHHL will be continued for all new eligible households: 1. All Below Poverty Line (BPL) households

facts.fact: Identified APL households are eligible: SC/ST, small and marginal farmers, landless labourers with homestead, households with a physically handicapped person, and women-headed households
facts.quote: a. Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes b. Small and marginal farmers c. Landless labourers with homestead d. Households having physically handicapped person e. Women headed households

facts.fact: Ineligible APL households are encouraged to build toilets at their own cost
facts.quote: All new ineligible APL households will be encouraged to construct toilets from their own resources.

facts.fact: Cost sharing is 60:40 Centre:State, 90:10 for North-Eastern States, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and J&K, and 100% Centre for the other UTs
facts.quote: fund sharing pattern between Centre and States being 90:10 for North-Eastern States, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and UT of Jammu and Kashmir; 100% from Centre for remaining Union Territories (UTs), and 60:40 for other States.

facts.fact: States/UTs may give a higher incentive from other sources
facts.quote: State/UT Governments will have the flexibility to provide higher incentive/additional funding from other sources

facts.fact: Rs 12,000 is an incentive, not reimbursement of the full cost of the toilet
facts.quote: Moreover, this is not the reimbursement of the cost of toilet which may be higher as well.

facts.fact: The IHHL application form is linked from the SBM-G website under Citizen Corner ('Application Form for IHHL', leading to SBM(G) Phase II citizen registration on sbm.gov.in)
facts.quote: Citizen Corner FAQs Application Form for IHHL Citizen’s Charter

facts.fact: New or left-out households approved by the district are supported by the Gram Panchayat to build their toilet
facts.quote: Households identified as a new household / left out household, as approved by the district, shall be supported by the Gram Panchayat to construct their Individual Household Latrine.

facts.fact: Urban households fall under a separate sub-mission, SBM (Urban), under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
facts.quote: and the Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) [SBM(U)] under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

summary: All SBM-G IHHL facts confirmed on the DDWS FAQ and Phase-II guidelines (Rs 12,000, BPL + identified APL, 60:40/90:10, IHHL form link, GP support, SBM-U separate).
